Aid Effectiveness: Sachs vs. Easterly Debate, RCTs, Conditional Cash Transfers

sections.text: Foreign aid has transferred over $5 trillion from rich to poor countries since World War II. Its effectiveness is vigorously debated. The debate resolves, partly, once you distinguish: aid for what? (emergency relief vs. long-run development), through what mechanism? (budget support vs. targeted projects), evaluated how? (macro correlations vs. RCTs).
